intro.h2: A kitchen that finally works the way you do
paragraphs: Battin Kitchen Designs offers kitchen design in Cochranton, PA, from its cabinet store on North Franklin Street. Jill Battin starts with what you need, like more counter space or more storage, and turns that list into a plan that fits your room and your style.

Her reviews tell the same story. One couple had an early 1960s kitchen that was cramped and dysfunctional, and Jill came up with a design they didn't think was possible. Another family had been told by other kitchen places that their idea couldn't be done. Jill did it, and they say the installation was done to perfection.

services.h2: How Jill helps with your kitchen

items.name: Kitchen design and layout
items.blurb: Tell Jill what isn't working, whether that is too little counter space, not enough storage or a layout that gets in your way. She turns that list into a design for your room, and customers say the result met needs they didn't think a new layout could solve.

image.alt: Cherry wood kitchen with a granite-topped island, pendant lights and tall pantry cabinets

items.name: Cabinets and products for your style
items.blurb: Choosing cabinets and finishes is easier with someone who knows the products. One customer says Jill was in tune with her style wishes and knew exactly which products worked to create her dream kitchen. The photos range from warm cherry wood to bright painted white.

image.alt: Wall of white painted cabinets with built-in microwave, oven and drawers beside a dining area

items.name: Updating older kitchens
items.blurb: Older homes often come with small, closed-in kitchens. Marion Z. started with an early 1960s kitchen that was cramped and dysfunctional. After talking through the family's list, Jill designed a new kitchen that met all of their needs, and the photos show the finished room.

image.alt: Dining table beside a cherry kitchen with granite counters and a glass door to the deck

items.name: Kitchen installation
items.blurb: A good design still has to be put in properly. Tina K.'s family had heard from other kitchen places that their plan couldn't be done, and they say the installation was done to perfection. Ask Jill how installation is arranged for your own project.

image.alt: View across a finished cherry kitchen with island, stainless refrigerator and tile floor

service_area.h2: Kitchen design in Cochranton and nearby
service_area.text: Battin Kitchen Designs is based at 156 N Franklin St in Cochranton, Pennsylvania. The Google listing does not name a service area, so if you live outside Cochranton and want to know whether Jill can design your kitchen, call (814) 573-2780 and ask. Have a short list ready of what you want to change in your kitchen, the way past customers did.

items.a: The cabinet store is at 156 N Franklin St, Cochranton, PA 16314. Store hours are not listed on Google, so please call (814) 573-2780 before you visit to make sure Jill is available to sit down and talk about your kitchen and your list.

items.q: Can you redesign an older kitchen?
items.a: Yes. One family started with an early 1960s kitchen that was cramped and dysfunctional. They listed what they wanted, like more counter space and more storage, and Jill came up with a design that met all of their needs. They say they didn't think it was possible.

items.q: Other companies said my idea can't be done. Can Jill help?
items.a: It is worth asking. Tina K.'s family had been told by other kitchen places that what they wanted couldn't be done. Jill did it, and they write that the installation was done to perfection and that they are extremely happy with their new kitchen.

items.q: What should I bring to the first conversation?
items.a: A list of what you want to change is a good start. Past customers began by listing and discussing what they were looking for, such as more counter space and more storage, and Jill built the design from that. Photos of your current kitchen can help too.

items.q: How do I get in touch?
items.a: Call Battin Kitchen Designs at (814) 573-2780 or email bkd@zoominternet.net. Tell Jill a little about your kitchen and what you would like to change, and she can explain how she would approach the design and what the next steps would be.
